soundtrack.alignment: fit continuous user-specified soundtrack to the original visual timeline

authorization.basis: User explicitly authorized this episode to use the two supplied appearance references and the specified roles.

A.appearance: short dark-brown tousled hair, slate-blue eyes, navy and gold coat and fringed epaulettes, ivory trousers and dark boots

B.appearance: long golden hair, crimson hood and gold-lined cape, dark trousers and gloves, red beads at both wrists and the ivory left-shoulder mask

shots.description: 椅边正面，神隐黑炎由平静转成挑衅
shots.direction: Front view by the rose chair, tilt the chin from a neutral smirk into an exaggerated challenge. Preserve the camera distance and dark wood background.

shots.description: 虚人梦隔着前景进入中焦，凝视对方
shots.direction: Medium view through blurred foreground. The red-hooded performer comes into focus by the doorway and holds an offscreen gaze.

shots.description: 偏低机位的侧脸，神隐黑炎歪头回望
shots.direction: Low three-quarter close-up of the officer tilting the head and glancing over with a comic smirk.

shots.description: 神隐黑炎侧脸跟随近景的舞台道具
shots.direction: Maintain the canted profile close-up, eyes following a harmless rounded theatrical prop in foreground, with no detailed mechanisms.

shots.description: 桌面俯拍，军服袖口伸到桌边
shots.direction: High table insert with navy-and-gold sleeves and hand motion. Any foreground object is a simplified nonfunctional stage prop.

shots.description: 靠桌前倾，随后拧身准备起立
shots.direction: Medium shot, lean forward over the table, twist sideways and begin to stand.

shots.description: 椅边起身，侧面机位保持原动作节奏
shots.direction: Side medium shot, quickly rise by the rose chair and make an exaggerated playing-to-the-room gesture.

shots.description: 走廊对峙，虚人梦转身，镜头沿房间后拉
shots.direction: Dark room pullback. Red-hooded performer turns away and moves deeper into the room; navy sleeves may pass the near edge. Use theatrical dust, paper scraps and broad amber light accents.

shots.description: 虚人梦落地蹲身，俯拍推进到面部
shots.direction: High-angle moving camera, the red-hooded performer drops into a deep crouch, turns their head and looks up as the camera comes nearer.

shots.description: 低机位，虚人梦蹲身抬手再起身
shots.direction: Very low camera from behind or behind three-quarter. Red hood stays visible while the performer lifts one hand from a crouch, sweeps it outward and starts to rise.

shots.description: 背面双手拍击，披风让开手部
shots.direction: Rear-view comic dance shot. Fully clothed performer remains facing away throughout, taps their own trouser-covered hips twice and spreads both arms. Keep the cape on either side so the hand contact reads, and keep the head or upper torso in the composition.

Begin in the canted rose-chair medium-wide view with the navy officer sitting in the right half. Push toward his face as he opens his mouth wide, then pull back smoothly on the same camera axis, finishing with one arm extending sideways. Match the actual rapid push and pull timing in the video. The officer consistently remains the only person.

shots.description: 从桌边换到侧角，暖色夸张闪光
shots.direction: Side view across dark table, officer makes an exaggerated forward gesture with abstract theatrical light flashes.

shots.description: 近背视角，虚人梦弯膝转胯
shots.direction: Near rear view, red-hooded performer bends both knees and swings the hips to the side, cape following the turn.

shots.description: 低机位宽景，虚人梦张臂摇摆
shots.direction: Wide low-angle view of the red-hooded performer shifting left then right and opening the arms, warm room and airborne stage glints.

Begin on the navy officer leaning forward by the rose chair, then the canted camera pulls back to show his upper body and the dark table. The officer extends his arm as an abstract amber theatre flare passes through the left foreground. Follow the continuous camera move, matching the start, middle and end body positions.

shots.description: 低角度中景，虚人梦扭身退到房间深处
shots.direction: Rear low-angle tracking view, red performer pivots and slides back into the room, cape and light glints moving with the body.

shots.description: 较高角度，虚人梦落到一膝并抬手
shots.direction: High three-quarter shot, red performer drops onto one knee and lifts open palms, coat folds follow the knee drop.

shots.description: 换高位背视，虚人梦侧转迈步
shots.direction: Rear high-angle shot, performer turns away from the camera and steps to the side, full red silhouette and deliberate foot contact.

Begin in close-up on the navy officer's expressive smiling face. As his smile changes suddenly and his body straightens, the camera pulls back fast to show both shoulders and extended arms. Finish at the wider scale with symmetrical amber stage effects near his open gestures. Use the source video for the face, pullback and arm timing.

One moving high-angle shot of the crimson performer on the wooden floor. Start with arms broadly spread against the floor, then the shoulders and knees roll in sequence, the camera lowers inward and the performer plants a gloved palm to push back toward a kneeling pose. Keep the red hood, black trousers and two feet clearly part of one continuous body.

shots.description: 地板贴近视角，靴子跨过画面
shots.direction: Floor-level view, dark boots cross the frame as the red cloak hem follows. Single figure remains evident through costume.

shots.description: 神隐黑炎正面展开双臂，灯光快速变化
shots.direction: Frontal medium-to-wide view; the officer rapidly opens both arms in a theatrical flourish. Keep the face and cloth legible through abstract light.

shots.description: 房间正面宽景，虚人梦站稳后抬臂
shots.direction: Front wide of red-hooded performer, one settling step then arms lift and spread, broken room behind.

shots.description: 仰拍，虚人梦跳步抬腿
shots.direction: Low camera, a nimble jump step with alternating knees and raised arms, red cloak lifting and settling.

Begin very close behind the fully clothed crimson performer, then quickly pull out to a low three-quarter rear view. Their bent legs land on the floor on separate beats and step out into a broader stance. The cape stays recognizable from the front of the next shot; match the near-to-wide camera move on the source timing.

shots.description: 高机位，虚人梦屈膝后向前展开动作
shots.direction: High camera, performer drops into a crouch then lunges and extends both hands playfully while keeping contact with the floor.

shots.description: 换仰角，虚人梦俯身后再次抬腿
shots.direction: Switch to a low angle, red performer bows and springs into a raised-knee dance step.

shots.description: 神隐黑炎侧向大动作，前景被光扫过
shots.direction: Tilted side view of the navy officer sweeping an arm across the screen, with a broad amber theatrical light sweep.

A floor-level following camera starts behind the crimson performer. Begin wide, showing the back, boots and rose chair behind. The performer spreads both arms, steps back and to either side, dips low, then turns toward the camera and extends one open hand into the right foreground. Use the original sequence, changing camera scale and full-body rhythm. Keep the red cape lifting naturally off the trousers without hiding the footwork.

Begin in a canted close-up on the navy officer's face as he shifts from comic smile to surprise. The camera continues pulling back behind the rose chair, revealing epaulettes and shoulders as he twists and opens his arms. A warm theatrical flare can wash across the foreground without becoming a different scene.

shots.description: 虚人梦以背面为主，在房间跳步回转
shots.direction: A very low canted camera starts behind the crimson performer at close range, quickly travels out to show the full figure and rose chair, then follows the performer through broad stepping and turning. Show the entire weight shift from foot to foot, arms crossing and opening as one foot reaches out at the end. Shape the red hood and cape clearly at both near and wide scales, with brief abstract amber stage glints.

shots.description: 虚人梦过肩回望
shots.direction: Close over-the-shoulder look back with visible gold hair, red hood and shoulder mask.

shots.description: 仰拍神隐黑炎抬头张口反应
shots.direction: Low-angle reaction of the officer tilting their head back and opening their mouth in comic disbelief.

shots.description: 低位全身，神隐黑炎摆开站姿
shots.direction: Low full-body view of the fully dressed navy officer in ivory trousers, changing foot placement and spreading one hand.

shots.description: 侧仰角，神隐黑炎急转并失去平衡
shots.direction: Side low angle, officer twists suddenly and loses balance in an exaggerated but harmless stumble.

One continuous high camera view moves with the navy officer as he stumbles through the wooded-floor corner, catches himself by the rose chair, then leans sideways with one open hand raised as the framing moves lower and closer. Keep his ivory breeches and closed navy coat consistent through all positions.

shots.description: 两人近距离交错，虚人梦和神隐黑炎各自保留造型
shots.direction: Canted two-person setup. Red hood and navy officer cross the frame in a theatrical comic standoff, comparable stature and clearly separated costumes.

shots.description: 短促对切，前景红兜帽与后景军服
shots.direction: Brief over-the-shoulder film cut. Red-hooded silhouette in near field, navy officer in the farther plane. Keep the roles spatially distinct.

shots.description: 俯拍神隐黑炎后仰，粉椅在背景
shots.direction: Overhead reaction, the navy officer leans back, changes facial expression and looks up, chair visible in the correct corner.

Use the single moving side angle of the wooden folding-screen corner. Begin with the navy officer nearer screen left and the crimson performer behind to the right. The crimson performer steps across and leans forward as the officer turns his face away and slides down by the left wall. Hold each distinct person in their own space and follow the original camera's continuous motion. Keep the officer seated low at the end.

shots.description: 低位视角，前景虚人梦回身观察
shots.direction: Near-floor composition, the red-hooded performer turns in foreground, navy officer remains farther away near the rose chair.

shots.description: 高位反切，神隐黑炎抬眼，虚人梦位于画面边缘
shots.direction: Top-down reverse angle, the officer reacts upward while the red cloak edge anchors the other character in foreground.

shots.description: 背后低角度，虚人梦竖指做夸张收势
shots.direction: Low rear angle, fully clothed red performer twists back and raises a finger in a playful finishing pose. Match the shoulder and foot placement.

shots.description: 神隐黑炎低位近景，从惊讶转为苦笑
shots.direction: Close canted view of the navy officer near the floor, lips and eyebrows change from stunned surprise to an awkward smile.

shots.description: 肩后角度，两位角色交换视线
shots.direction: Over-the-shoulder two-shot. Navy officer watches while the red performer leans in and turns their head; maintain clothing and size consistency.

shots.description: 低机位短反切，保持两人相对位置
shots.direction: Brief low-angle reaction of the navy officer in background and the red-cloaked character in foreground, preserving their positions.

shots.description: 俯拍收尾，虚人梦弯身，神隐黑炎留在后景
shots.direction: Match the high look down toward the folding screen and floor. The crimson performer starts bent forward at center-right, straightens briefly with feet planted and arms moving behind the cloak, then folds forward again to finish. The navy officer remains seated low on the left by the wall, his face and navy shoulders separated clearly from the crimson cape. Keep the warm patterned screen in the same location through the end.

cutRevision.reason: Inspect adjacent frames at every planned boundary and keep continuous camera moves in one model input. Shot numbers from the first plan remain stable for already recorded production attempts.
